coastal.title: Man hospitalized after police-involved shooting in Burnaby
coastal.description: One man is in hospital with serious injuries and the province's civilian police oversight agency is investigating after a police-involved shooting in Burnaby on Sunday morning, RCMP say.

coastal.title: Pattullo Bridge arches to be removed over Thanksgiving long weekend
coastal.description: Business owners near the Pattullo Bridge hope improved traffic flow will mean more customers, as crews began removing the bridge’s steel arches Friday — one more step toward completing the long-awaited replacement project.

coastal.title: Strong winds topple trees, knock out power to thousands in B.C.'s Lower Mainland
coastal.description: British Columbia's Lower Mainland got an early taste of fall weather on Friday, with strong winds pummeling the region.

kamloops.title: B.C. woman who married ISIS fighter pleads guilty to terrorism charge
kamloops.description: Kimberly Polman pleaded guilty to one count of leaving Canada to participate in the activities of a terrorist group, the Public Prosecution Service of Canada confirmed.

prince-george.title: Roller hockey players frustrated by Burnaby ban on inline skates at sports boxes
prince-george.description: Inline skates have been banned from Burnaby’s two newest multi-use sports boxes, leaving roller hockey players concerned about the next generation of players and with few options to play outdoors.

all.title: Officials adjust border crossing hours as B.C. drops seasonal time change
all.description: British Columbia's decision to end time changes has prompted the Canada Border Services Agency to alter its opening hours at nine land crossings to align with neighbouring U.S. ports of entry.
